races.paceDynamic: Stag Night is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the front without serious pressure, allowing him to set sustainable fractions on soft ground. Cuban Grey, Likedbymike, Buddy Batt and Ribble Emperor will track in prominent positions but none are aggressive early pace-forcers. The moderate gallop will suit patient hold-up horses like Shadow Of The Moon, Gazelle d'Or, Noble Nation and Sarahmae who can unleash finishing kicks. This controlled tempo strongly favours hold-up horses and closers who can produce late acceleration.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Hold-Up Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Stag Night sets uncontested fractions and the pace stays moderate throughout
scenarios.body: The patient hold-up horses get ideal conditions to wind up late runs, with Noble Nation and Shadow Of The Moon perfectly positioned to strike. Gazelle d'Or and Sarahmae also benefit from the tactical setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Cuban Grey or Likedbymike challenge Stag Night earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased pace stretches the field more but still allows prominent racers to dominate the finish. Buddy Batt's consistent 5f form and Likedbymike's class edge come to the fore.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Stag Night gets completely uncontested lead and kicks clear turning for home
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows him to save energy for a decisive move, with his recent Curragh form giving him course advantage. Only the strongest finishers can reel him in.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy Sprint Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If multiple horses converge simultaneously in final furlong creating traffic problems
scenarios.body: The chaotic finish favours horses with proven 5f speed and clean runs, particularly those drawn favourably. Sommelier's finishing concerns become critical in a tight bunch finish.

races.paceDynamic: Astute Power is the lone confirmed front runner and will set uncontested fractions in this large field, with prominent runners like Reposado, Art Of Unity, Royal Impact, and Eichan San settling just behind but unlikely to pressure the leader early. The bulk of this field are hold-up horses who will be relying on the strong pace to come back to them, but with only one horse committed to making the running, the tempo may be more sedate than ideal for closers. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can track the lone leader and kick clear before the wall of hold-up horses can get organized from deep positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominant
scenarios.trigger: If Astute Power sets moderate fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The prominent pack of Reposado, Royal Impact, Eichan San and Art Of Unity will have first run on the field and can establish winning positions before the hold-up brigade gets going. With so many closers needing the same late run, traffic problems are inevitable.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Stays
scenarios.trigger: If Astute Power maintains his kick after setting comfortable fractions
scenarios.body: With no serious pace pressure early, Astute Power can dictate terms throughout and prove hard to peg back despite his 130-day absence. The lack of early pace makes it harder for the swarm of hold-up horses to reel him in.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Breakthrough
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple prominent runners pushing forward
scenarios.body: This would set up perfectly for the better hold-up horses like Rappell, Alnofoor and Blue Anthem to come with late runs. The soft ground aids their stamina reserves in the final furlong charge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the favorites hit traffic problems or fail to handle the soft conditions
scenarios.body: Long-absent runners like Carrigans Grove (205 days off) or Nouvel Espoir (168 days) could exploit a messy finish. The large field and single pace angle creates opportunities for unconsidered runners.

races.paceDynamic: Cantilever sits as the sole confirmed pace-setter in this 24-runner maiden, giving him a clear tactical advantage on soft ground where front-runners can dictate. With no genuine speed rivals to pressure him early, Cantilever can control fractions and potentially steal a march on this large field. The lack of pace pressure means prominent runners like Starman Tom, Cactus, and Thenandnow will need to work harder to get into contention, while hold-up horses face the challenge of navigating traffic in a big field with potentially slow early fractions. This race shape clearly favours the front-runner and any early prominent horses who can secure good positions behind the leader.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Cantilever Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Cantilever gets an uncontested lead and maintains sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: He can kick clear turning for home before the field can organize, with any prominently-raced horses struggling to reel him in on the testing ground. The large field and slow early pace make it difficult for hold-up horses to mount effective challenges.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple horses tracking Cantilever closely
scenarios.body: The front-runner weakens in the final furlong, allowing well-positioned prominent runners to surge past with superior finishing kicks. Cactus and Starman Tom benefit from Ryan Moore's tactical nous and steady recent form respectively.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Navigation
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Strong stayers like Glen And Tonic and Magna Kotcha can weave through traffic to deliver late challenges despite the tactical disadvantage. The soft ground aids their stamina reserves in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Maiden Surprise Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the established form horses fail to fire and one of the newcomers shows unexpected ability
scenarios.body: A well-bred debutant from the O'Brien or Stack yards springs a surprise, benefiting from the tactical chaos and inexperience throughout the field. Grande Cuvee or Ragaire could be the beneficiaries with strong stable connections.

The prominent runners like Sun Soldier, Smoke Them Out, and Mickey The Steel will track closely behind but won't apply serious early pressure. With 11 hold-up horses including Real Force, Goal Exceeded, and San Aer needing to make ground late, the race sets up perfectly for horses racing on or close to the pace. This tactical setup strongly favours prominent runners and the lone front-runner who can dictate terms without pressure.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.trigger: If L L Koulsty gets an easy lead and isn't seriously challenged until late.
scenarios.body: The pace will be comfortable allowing him to save energy for a strong finish, while the hold-up horses face too much to do from the back of this large field. His recent Curragh form and proven stamina give him every chance to capitalize on ideal tactical conditions.
